title: Analista de Governança Microsoft Pleno | Senior
description:
Analista de Governança Microsoft - Pleno / Sênior

Missão

Atuar como referência de governança e sustentação técnica (nível N3) para o ecossistema Microsoft, garantindo estabilidade, segurança, conformidade e controle de custos principalmente em Power Platform, SharePoint Online e Copilot Studio. A posição combina administração de plataforma com capacidade prática de construção e troubleshooting de soluções low-code e agentes.

A administração e governança desses produtos é centralizada nos centros de administração (Power Platform Admin Center etc.) e envolve proteger dados, controlar acessos e monitorar o que makers/usuários fazem.

Escopo de atuação

Microsoft (Power Platform, Dataverse, SharePoint Online, M365/Entra, Copilot Studio)

Administração pontual / governança leve de plataformas de IA corporativa (Gemini Enterprise, OpenAI Enterprise, NotebookLM) (ex.: gestão de acessos, onboarding, padrões e controles básicos)

Requisitos

1) Administração e Sustentação da Plataforma (N3)

Administrar ambientes (criação, padronização, saneamento, controle de capacidade e permissões), garantindo operação estável e previsível.

Executar rotinas de manutenção, saneamento e ajustes técnicos (ex.: ambientes órfãos, owners, conectores, políticas, agentes e automações fora de padrão).

Definir e manter runbooks e procedimentos operacionais para incidentes recorrentes e auditorias.

2) Governança e Segurança (Power Platform + Copilot Studio + M365)

Implementar e operar políticas de governança: DLP, segmentação de conectores (Business/Non-Business), padrões de ambientes e critérios de publicação.

Garantir aderência a controles de Copilot Studio (ex.: data policies, autenticação, conectores/ações, roteamento de ambientes, logs e rastreabilidade).

3) Desenvolvimento e Troubleshooting (N3 Maker) — obrigatório

Desenvolver e dar suporte avançado (N3) em:Agentes no Copilot Studio (conectores, knowledge sources, autenticação, governança de publicação e segurança).

Power Apps (Canvas e/ou Model-driven conforme necessidade) e Power Automate (cloud flows, integrações e automações administrativas).

Diagnosticar incidentes complexos de makers/ambientes (erros de permissão, conectores, falhas de execução, limites/capacidade, problemas de DLP e ALM).

4) Administração do Dataverse (capacidade, saúde e KPIs)

Administrar o Dataverse garantindo utilização dentro de KPIs (capacidade, performance, organização e governança do inventário).

Monitorar e corrigir causas de degradação (crescimento descontrolado, ambientes mal configurados, automações etc.).

Apoiar governança de dados/entidades relevantes ao CoE e relatórios operacionais.

5) Gestão de custos e sustentabilidade financeira

Controlar e reportar custos e consumo de:Power Apps / Power Automate

Copilot Studio (agentes)

Propor medidas de otimização (racionalização de ambientes, consolidação/arquivamento, revisão de owners/licenças, desativação de ativos sem uso, melhoria de governança de conectores)

6) Operação do CoE (Power Platform + Copilot Studio)

Sobre a Empresa

Oportunidade para atuar na Rede D'Or no Hospital Quinta D'or. Empresa fundada em 1977, a Rede D'Or é a maior rede privada de cuidados integrados do Brasil com presença em São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Paraná, Distrito Federal, Pernambuco, Maranhão, Sergipe, Pará, Paraíba, Minas Gerais, Mato Grosso do Sul, Ceará, Bahia, Alagoas. title: Sales Development Representative (SDR)
description:

title: Coordenador de Planejamento e Controle
description:
O movimento da vida gera resultados e também resíduos.

Isso faz parte do ciclo natural de uma cidade viva e em constante transformação. Mas acreditamos que esses resíduos podem ter um destino melhor e possível continuando a gerar valor e mantendo a vida em movimento.

Foi com esse propósito que nasceu a Regenera Rio.

Uma empresa dedicada a transformar a forma como o Rio de Janeiro lida com seus resíduos, provenientes de residências, comércios e indústrias, garantindo um destino ambientalmente adequado. Tudo pensado para que o ciclo do saneamento básico seja completo: do transporte ao tratamento.

Um movimento que impulsiona a economia local, apoia a geração de empregos diretos e indiretos, fortalece a cadeia da reciclagem e contribui para uma cidade mais limpa e sustentável.

Essa transformação reduz os impactos ambientais causados pela destinação incorreta dos resíduos, promove melhorias diretas na saúde e na qualidade de vida da população carioca e impulsiona a economia circular, conectando pessoas, negócios e meio ambiente.

Missão do cargo:

Buscamos um(a) Coordenador(a) de Planejamento e Controle para atuar de forma estratégica no processo de FP&A, com forte integração às áreas operacionais e papel essencial no suporte à tomada de decisão da alta administração, por meio de análises econômico-financeiras robustas e modelos financeiros complexos.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Coordenar e acompanhar os processos de planejamento estratégico, orçamento anual, revisões periódicas (forecast) e controle orçamentário;
  • Desenvolver, estruturar e manter modelos financeiros complexos, incluindo:
  • Projeções financeiras de longo prazo;
  • Modelos de viabilidade econômico-financeira;
  • Simulações de cenários (sensibilidade, stress, upside e downside);
  • Modelos contratuais com múltiplos indexadores e diferentes estruturas de reajuste;
  • Atuar como parceiro estratégico das áreas operacionais, contratos, engenharia e comercial, traduzindo dados técnicos e operacionais em impactos financeiros claros e acionáveis;
  • Apoiar negociações contratuais, revisões de preços, pleitos e processos de reequilíbrio econômico-financeiro;
  • Estruturar, acompanhar e analisar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) financeiros e operacionais;

Requisitos técnicos

  • Formação superior completa em Engenharia, Economia, Administração, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas;
  • Sólida experiência em Planejamento e Controle Financeiro (FP&A);
  • Domínio avançado de modelagem financeira, especialmente em Excel (ou ferramentas equivalentes), incluindo:
  • Experiência com contratos de longo prazo, concessões ou setores intensivos em capital (infraestrutura, saneamento, resíduos, energia ou similares);

Diferenciais desejáveis

  • Experiência em empresas de infraestrutura, saneamento, meio ambiente ou serviços públicos;
  • Vivência com indexadores econômicos, reajustes contratuais e processos de reequilíbrio econômico-financeiro;

Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta!

Atuamos na Região Metropolitana do Rio de Janeiro.

Estamos presentes de forma estruturada e integrada na cidade do Rio de Janeiro e Região Metropolitana, com unidades operacionais localizadas em pontos estratégicos para o recebimento, transferência, tratamento e destinação ambientalmente adequada dos resíduos coletados.

Nosso compromisso é transformar a forma como os resíduos são geridos, criando valor ambiental, social e econômico a partir do que antes era descartado. Onde outros veem fim, nós enxergamos recomeço: onde tudo tenha a chance de se regenerar.

title: Desenvolvedor C# Sênior
description:
Inscrição

Para se candidatar, envie seu currículo atualizado para:

Descrição da Vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) C# Sênior com sólida experiência em todo o ciclo de vida de desenvolvimento de software. Buscamos alguém que domine boas práticas de engenharia, esteja familiarizado com arquiteturas modernas em ambiente cloud (AWS) e seja capaz de liderar tecnicamente projetos de médio e grande porte.

O(a) candidato(a) ideal deve ser capaz de conceber, desenvolver, testar e gerenciar aplicações complexas de forma consistente, garantindo alta qualidade, performance e segurança no código.

Responsabilidades

  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter aplicações escaláveis em C#/.NET 8 seguindo padrões de DDD e CQRS, garantindo alta performance e segurança.
  • Implementar e evoluir camadas de domínio e aplicação utilizando MediatR, AutoMapper e FluentValidation.
  • Trabalhar com Entity Framework Core e Dapper em banco PostgreSQL, realizando modelagem, otimização de consultas e manutenção de migrations.
  • Integrar e gerenciar serviços AWS, incluindo ECS, RDS Aurora, S3, SES, ElastiCache/Redis, Secrets Manager e CloudFormation.
  • Desenvolver e manter integrações com provedores de identidade (Azure AD, Okta, OpenID Connect) e APIs externas (Microsoft Graph, OData).
  • Implementar e monitorar jobs em background com Hangfire e comunicação real-time com SignalR.
  • Criar e manter suítes de testes automatizados com xUnit (unitários e integração).
  • Participar ativamente de code reviews, definições de arquitetura e mentoria de desenvolvedores mais juniores em ambiente ágil (Scrum/Kanban).
  • Colaborar na manutenção de pipelines CI/CD (Azure Pipelines e AWS CodePipeline) e na containerização de serviços com Docker.

Qualificações Obrigatórias

  • Formação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou área correlata.
  • 5+ anos de experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento back-end com C# e .NET (preferencialmente .NET 6+).
  • Experiência sólida com Entity Framework Core e bancos PostgreSQL ou similares, incluindo modelagem relacional e otimização de queries.
  • Conhecimento prático de padrões de arquitetura: DDD, CQRS, SOLID, Clean Code.
  • Experiência com serviços AWS (ECS, RDS, S3, SES ou equivalentes).

Conceitos e fundamentos da educação profissional e tecnológica; normativas que regulamentam a Aprendizagem Profissional (Lei no 10.097/2000; Decreto 9.579/2018; Portaria MTE 3.872/2023; dentre outras); informações técnico/operacionais da Aprendizagem Profissional; Catálogo Nacional da Aprendizagem (CONAP) e Cadastro Nacional da Aprendizagem Profissional (CNAP); redação de textos técnicos educacionais; Pacote Office em nível intermediário; ferramentas de apresentação (Canva, PowerPoint, Prezi entre outros).

  • Copilot Studio: Desenvolvimento de soluções baseadas em inteligência artificial, incluindo a criação de agentes personalizados para automação de atendimento e integração com sistemas corporativos;

title: Accounting Manager
description:
TGG Way Accounting Manager

Location: Fully Remote working for US-Based Clients

We are a dynamic and growing accounting firm specializing in providing financial services across a wide range of industries. Our team is composed of highly skilled professionals who are passionate about delivering exceptional results and building long-term client relationships. TGG Accounting is growing, and we’re looking for an Accounting Manager to join our remote team.


The Accounting Manager owns all accounting outcomes for assigned clients, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and adherence to TGG Way standards. They oversee Staff Accountant transactional work, uphold controls and processes, and guide team execution to deliver reliable financial statements to the Controller.


Responsibilities

Weekly

• Review customer invoicing

• Review vendor bills and submit payments

• Approve and submit payroll

• Perform P&L scrubs

• Review cash flow forecasts

• Resolve collections issues

• Manage weekly recurring accounting processes as directed by the Controller

Monthly

• Complete the full client Technical QA checklist through the Month-End Workbook

• Ensure accuracy of the balance sheet workbook

• Perform source document filing spot checks

• Calculate monthly sales tax prepayments and submit to Controller for review and

payment

• Review the final P&L scrub and approve journal entries prepared by the Staff

Accountant

• Review and finalize financial notes in financial packages

• Review financial statements and supporting schedules prepared by the Staff

Accountant

• Understand the purpose of existing KPIs and roll them forward each month

• Confirm financial accuracy across statements, KPIs, executive summaries, charts,

graphs, and footnotes

• Provide feedback to Staff Accountants about technical updates to improve their

technical accounting skills

• Review process and procedural documents

Quarterly

• Complete 941 reconciliations

• Prepare and submit sales tax returns with Controller approval

Annually

• Coordinate, review, and submit 1099s annually

• Review the chart of accounts

• Reclassify contributions and distributions from the balance sheet and income

statement to retained earnings

• Provide recommendations to improve client efficiency

• Prepare and submit client personal property tax filings for Controller review

New Client Implementation

• Review new client’s current process and procedural documents

• Recommend and document new processes for the Controller to sign off on

• Create initial reports including Cash Flow Forecast, AP Tracker, Month-End

Workbook, and Financial Package

• Delegate updates to Staff Accountant


Requirements

  • 4+ years of accounting experience
  • Experience working with U.S.-based clients and exposure to U.S. GAAP
  • Strong understanding of month-end close, journal entries, and reconciliations
  • Proficiency in QuickBooks Online or NetSuite (preferred)

  • Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment

  • Fully remote role with some flexibility included
  • Paid training in U.S. GAAP and internal processes
  • Access to TGG University and learning resources
  • Career development / Long-term growth opportunities within a global firm
  • PTO after onboarding period (most local holidays included)

Working Equipment to start is required

title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Job description

We are looking for a Senior Infrastructure Engineer to join a North American team supporting a hybrid environment with a strong focus on VMware and Azure Cloud. This role is primarily hands-on and involves managing, modernizing, and migrating a large-scale virtualized environment to the cloud, while also supporting core networking and security components. The ideal candidate brings deep VMware and Azure experience, strong production support capabilities, and the ability to work across infrastructure, cloud, and networking domains in a collaborative, hybrid-specialist team.


Roles and Responsibilities

  • Manage and optimize a large VMware environment across multiple physical hosts.
  • Support migration initiatives from on-premises VMware infrastructure to Microsoft Azure.
  • Design and implement cloud-based solutions in Azure, ensuring scalability, security, and high availability.
  • Build and maintain disaster recovery strategies across on-premises and cloud environments.
  • Administer and support VMware platforms, including vCenter, vSAN, and related virtualization components.
  • Support and manage Microsoft 365 (O365) services within the broader infrastructure ecosystem.
  • Monitor system performance and troubleshoot infrastructure issues across virtualized, cloud, and network layers.
  • Support networking components including firewalls, routing, switching, VPNs, and secure access solutions.
  • Work with security platforms such as Zscaler and contribute to overall infrastructure security posture.
  • Participate in modernization projects aimed at improving system performance, scalability, and operational efficiency.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional IT and security teams to align infrastructure with business needs.
  • Maintain accurate technical documentation, system diagrams, and operational procedures.


Job Requirements

  • 8–10+ years of hands-on experience in infrastructure engineering, systems administration, or hybrid cloud environments.
  • Strong expertise in VMware technologies (vSphere, vCenter, vSAN) in production environments.
  • Solid hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure, including migrations, compute, networking, and storage services.
  • Proven experience managing and supporting large virtualized environments.
  • Experience designing and implementing disaster recovery solutions across hybrid infrastructures.
  • Working knowledge of core networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, VLANs, VPNs, routing, and switching.
  • Experience with secure access and SASE platforms such as Zscaler is preferred.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft 365 (O365) administration.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across infrastructure, cloud, and networking layers.
  • Experience with performance monitoring tools and infrastructure observability.
  • Ability to work in a hybrid specialist team and handle multiple responsibilities across domains.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to prioritize work in a dynamic environment.
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., VMware, Azure, CCNP) are preferred but not mandatory if experience is strong.

  • Strong knowledge of Order-to-Cash (O2C) processes.

  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (controls, reconciliations, reporting).

title: Risk Management Officer
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including;
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements
  • Net-worth monitoring;
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
  • Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.
  • Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management.


Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.
  • Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English .
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
  • not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Role Overview


Syntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Additionally, you will manage the company’s foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration.


Key Responsibilities


Business Process Engineering (Core Expectation)

  • Conduct needs assessments with department leads to identify operational bottlenecks and manual processes.
  • Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes.
  • Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations.
  • Manage change adoption by providing training, documentation, and ongoing support for newly implemented tools.

Automation, Integration & AI Implementation

  • Design, build, and maintain system integrations across our SaaS ecosystem utilizing REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom scripts (Python, JavaScript).
  • Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks.
  • Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software.

IT Administration & Security

  • Administer core software platforms and directories, including (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365).
  • Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access.
  • Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security.
  • Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate SaaS contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl.


Required Qualifications & Skills


Technical Experience:

  • 5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration.
  • Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment.
  • Strong understanding of cloud-based SaaS ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures.
  • High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting.
  • Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows.
  • Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols.


Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies:

  • Communication: Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity.
  • Critical Thinking: Strong analytical approach to problem-solving; ability to identify the root causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms.
  • Decision-Making: Highly autonomous execution; capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions.


Benefits & Compensation

  • Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

title: Data Scientist - Catálogo
description:
No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro , maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina , e a Fisia , distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Buscamos uma pessoa Cientista de Dados para atuar na squad de Catálogo , com foco em qualidade, enriquecimento e padronização de dados de produtos, utilizando técnicas de Inteligência artificial.

Essa posição tem papel estratégico na evolução do catálogo como ativo central do negócio, atuando desde a definição de hipóteses até a implementação, experimentação e mensuração de impacto, com forte interface com Produto, Engenharia, Design e Negócio.


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e evoluir soluções baseadas em IA e Machine Learning para enriquecimento automático de produtos, como:
  • Padronização de descrições e títulos
  • Inferência e sugestão de atributos
  • Classificação e reclassificação de produtos


  • Atuar na definição e otimização de:
  • Modelos e regras de categorização de produtos
  • Estratégias de enriquecimento e validação automática de atributos
  • Métricas de qualidade de catálogo (completude, consistência, acurácia e unicidade)


  • Trabalhar com modelos supervisionados e não supervisionados, incluindo abordagens baseadas em NLP e LLMs, quando aplicável.
  • Avaliar e evoluir métricas que conectem qualidade de catálogo com impacto em negócio e experiência do usuário (ex: conversão, busca, recomendação).
  • Conduzir testes A/B e experimentos controlados para validar o impacto das melhorias de enriquecimento e qualidade do catálogo.
  • Traduzir problemas de negócio e operacionais em soluções analíticas e modelos de dados escaláveis.
  • Atuar em parceria com Engenharia, Produto e áreas de negócio na definição do roadmap técnico de catálogo.
  • Garantir boas práticas de ciência de dados: versionamento, documentação, reprodutibilidade e monitoramento das soluções baseadas em IA.
  • Apoiar tecnicamente outros cientistas de dados do time, elevando o nível das discussões técnicas e decisões analíticas.


Requisitos necessários:

  • Formação superior completa em Ciência da Computação, Estatística, Matemática ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência comprovada de 5 a 7 anos em projetos de ciência de dados.
  • Experiência prática com problemas de classificação, enriquecimento ou qualidade de dados.
  • Forte domínio de SQL para análise de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Proficiência em Python para análise de dados, experimentação e modelagem.
  • Experiência com modelos de machine learning aplicados a dados estruturados.
  • Vivência com experimentação e testes A/B em ambientes de produto digital.
  • Experiência com ambientes de dados em nuvem (ex: BigQuery, data lakes).
  • Capacidade de comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Experiência em produtos digitais com alto volume e complexidade de dados.
  • Noções de MLOps.
  • Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência prévia com catálogo de produtos, e-commerce ou marketplace.
  • Conhecimento em modelagem de dados e governança de dados.
  • Vivência com detecção de anomalias e métricas de qualidade de dados.
  • Experiência com pipelines de dados e integração entre sistemas.
  • Conhecimento em NLP aplicado a dados de produtos (ex: normalização de descrições, extração de atributos).
  • Conhecimento em visualização de dados e storytelling analítico.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de business intelligence, como Power BI.


Perfil esperado:

  • Forte mentalidade de qualidade de dados como produto.
  • Perfil analítico, curioso e orientado a impacto de negócio.
  • Autonomia para conduzir iniciativas complexas de ponta a ponta.
  • Capacidade de influenciar decisões técnicas e de produto com dados.
  • Boa colaboração em times multidisciplinares.

title: Senior Salesforce Developer
description:
Senior Salesforce Developer

Brazil


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior Salesforce Developer with Data Cloud experience to support a strategic initiative focused on reducing customer churn by integrating and enriching customer data across multiple platforms. This role will work closely with the Salesforce Architect, data engineering teams, and cross-functional partners to ingest, unify, and expose data within Salesforce CRM and Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud).

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Lead end-to-end ingestion and mapping of customer data from Salesforce CRM, Siebel, Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, and churn model outputs into Salesforce Data 360;
  • Design, build, and maintain identity and account unification rules to produce accurate customer matching and golden records;
  • Create scalable, repeatable pipelines for ingestion, transformation, mapping, and controlled promotion across environments (including Data 360 data kits);
  • Enrich Salesforce CRM records with Data 360 attributes and analytics/model insights (e.g., churn) using related lists, dynamic related lists, and custom UI components;
  • Support CRM data strategy during the Siebel-to-Salesforce migration, prioritizing Salesforce CRM as the system of engagement as adoption increases;
  • Develop and support APIs and integration services for secure internal consumption of Data 360 and CRM data; partner with architecture/engineering on integration patterns and implement ETL when native connectors don’t meet requirements;
  • Monitor and optimize Data 360 credit consumption to balance cost, performance, and SLAs;
  • Enable business teams to use enriched customer data for segmentation, activation, and analytics use cases;
  • Document processes, standards, and runbooks; contribute to shared enablement resources to drive adoption and operational continuity.

Essential Skills

  • Experience with Salesforce development;
  • Strong proficiency in: Apex, SOQL/SOSL, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce core data model, Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP/Bulk), and integration design patterns;
  • Hands-on experience with Data ingestion and harmonization, Identity resolution and unification rules, Data kits and environment promotion, Large-scale data processing;
  • Experience connecting Salesforce Data Cloud/Data 360 to external systems (Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, Siebel, or similar), including when to use native connectors vs. custom integrations;
  • Experience with ETL processes and/or tools (e.g., Informatica, MuleSoft, Talend, Databricks);
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams;
  • Strong technical communication skills, able to translate complex concepts for architects, engineers, business users, and leadership;
  • Advanced English to be in contact with customer representative on a daily basis.

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, especially data activation and segmentation;
  • Experience with Siebel CRM integration and/or data migration;
  • Knowledge of telecom customer data, churn analytics, or Customer 360 implementations;
  • Familiarity with Azure data engineering and Microsoft Fabric connector limitations;
  • Understanding of scalable deployment pipelines and DevOps tooling (Git, CI/CD).

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.

title: Cientista de dados
description:

Hoje atua como financiadora da cadeia de insumos do agronegócio, visando ser seu sistema operacional e principal parceiro financeiro. Possui mais de 1 bilhão de reais sob gestão, captou 75 milhões em rodada de investimentos e atua com clientes em todo o Brasil.


O Desafio e o Time de Modelagem

Como uma startup em constante desenvolvimento, nosso ambiente é dinâmico e exige autonomia. O Time de Modelagem é enxuto e focado em resolver problemas complexos de risco de crédito e de análise de dados no agronegócio. Buscamos um Cientista de Dados experiente, com perfil voltado para mentoria e trabalho em equipe.

Acreditamos em um ambiente de trabalho livre e flexível, por isso, a confiança é a base de tudo que fazemos. Valorizamos pessoas movidas a novos desafios, capazes de desbravar o agronegócio e nos ajudar na nossa principal missão, que é levar para o agronegócio o insumo mais importante: o crédito.


Dia a dia

  • Desenvolver, implementar e monitorar modelos estatísticos e de machine learning, especialmente modelos de credit scoring e análise de risco.
  • Produtizar os modelos, trabalhando de forma autônoma desde a concepção até a implementação em ambiente de produção.
  • Colaborar com a liderança técnica na definição da arquitetura de dados e nas escolhas tecnológicas do time.
  • Traduzir problemas complexos de negócio em soluções baseadas em dados, comunicando os resultados de forma clara para audiências técnicas e não técnicas.
  • Colaborar dinamicamente com os times de produto e engenharia.
  • Manter-se atualizado com tendências e melhores práticas em Engenharia e Ciência de Dados.


Requisitos

  • 3+ anos de experiência atuando como Cientista de Dados, preferencialmente em ambientes de startup ou empresas de tecnologia.
  • Domínio em probabilidade e estatística e em modelos de machine learning supervisionados e não supervisionados.
  • Domínio em Python e principais bibliotecas para Ciência de Dados (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, etc.).
  • Forte conhecimento em SQL (modelagem, performance e manipulação de grandes volumes de dados).
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento e operacionalização de pipelines de machine learning ponta a ponta em produção (exploração e preparação de dados, limpeza, engenharia de atributos, modelagem e avaliação), com foco em escalabilidade, reprodutibilidade, segurança e monitoramento contínuo de performance dos modelos.
  • Experiência com práticas de engenharia para produção de modelos, incluindo versionamento de código com Git/Github, deploy em nuvem, automação de fluxos e suporte ao monitoramento e manutenção dos modelos em produção.
  • Familiaridade com serviços em nuvem, preferencialmente Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Perfil proativo, com capacidade para atuar em problemas ambíguos, autonomia para estruturar o caminho analítico e excelente habilidade de comunicação para alinhamento com múltiplos stakeholders.
  • Interesse genuíno em evoluir tecnicamente em um ambiente dinâmico de fintech.


Diferenciais

  • Formação acadêmica em Estatística, Ciência da Computação, Ciência de Dados, Engenharias, Matemática, Física, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia com modelagem de risco de crédito, credit scoring ou detecção de fraudes.

title: Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo

Mackay Marine é uma empresa global de serviço eletrônicos marítimos com mais de 450 funcionários em 45 depósitos de serviços em 17 países, incluindo Américas, Europa, África e Ásia. Por mais de cinquenta (50) anos, a Mackay vendeu, instalou e atendeu equipamentos de navegação e comunicação a bordo de navios comerciais e navais, iates e embarcações de recreio. A Mackay garante o sucesso de nossos funcionários investindo em treinamento contínuo na fábrica e fornecendo todas as peças, suporte técnico e administrativo necessários. Também oferecemos salários competitivos, horas extras, benefícios e oportunidades de crescimento com base no mérito.


A Mackay Marine Brasil atualmente tem vagas em nossas localidade do Rio para Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo com experiência, habilidades e qualificações abaixo. Mackay se originou e está sediada nos EUA, é necessário ter proficiência em falar, ler e escrever em inglês.


Resumo do Trabalho de Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo:

Sob supervisão limitada, os Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo (MST) instalam, fazem manutenção e reparam equipamentos eletrônicos marítimos a bordo de navios comerciais e navais, iates e embarcações de recreio. Eles testam, ajustam e solucionam problemas de componentes, PCBs, subconjuntos e antenas, bem como carregam, atualizam e modificam o software. Os Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo utilizam seus conhecimentos de teoria e circuitos eletrônicos para resolver uma variedade de problemas técnicos, bem como para fazer uso inteligente de esquemas complexos, projetos e manuais para realizar tarefas com precisão. Após a conclusão de cada trabalho, o técnico redigirá e enviará um relatório de serviço detalhado.


Tipos de equipamentos atendidos:

• Radares

• ECDIS

• Satcoms

• Rádios HF e VHF

• GPS

• Girobússola

• Pilotos automáticos

• Sirenes


Qualificações do Técnico em Marítima:

• Mais de 3 anos como MST na indústria de transporte marítimo comercial.

• Um diploma universitário em engenharia ou certificações técnicas equivalentes.

• Proficiente em falar, ler e escrever em inglês.

• Forte conhecimento de teoria e aplicação de eletrônica.

• Licença de Operador de Rádio GMDSS preferencialmente.

title: Cloud Operations Engineer
description:
About Eightpoint


Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U.S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


The Cloud Operations Engineer will provide hands-on operational support across Eightpoint's multi-cloud infrastructure spanning AWS and GCP. This role focuses on maintaining reliability, supporting CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring observability across all environments while enabling the DevOps team to focus on project-driven initiatives. The position reports to the Director of IT & Cybersecurity and works closely with the DevOps and Systems Administration teams.


Key Responsibilities


  • Administer and support AWS infrastructure including EKS clusters, Elastic Beanstalk environments, EC2, S3, CloudFront, RDS, and IAM across a multi-account environment
  • Support GCP workloads, primarily BigQuery pipelines and related data infrastructure.
  • Maintain and troubleshoot self-hosted applications including Airflow, Grafana, and other internal tooling.
  • Support and maintain CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions, including self-hosted runners.
  • Participate in incident response processes — triage, root cause analysis, remediation, and post-incident documentation.
  • Deploy, configure, and maintain logging, monitoring, and alerting tooling (Grafana stack — Loki, Tempo, Mimir, Alloy; CloudWatch; OneUptime).
  • Manage infrastructure-as-code using Terraform.
  • Participate in on-call rotation providing support across US and offshore time zones.
  • Contribute to documentation in Confluence and maintain runbooks for operational procedures.


Who You Are


  • 5+ years of experience in a cloud operations, DevOps, or infrastructure support role.
  • Strong working knowledge of AWS core services (EKS, Elastic Beanstalk, EC2, S3, IAM, VPC, RDS, CloudFront).
  • Hands-on experience administering containerized workloads (Kubernetes/EKS, Docker).
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions.
  • Demonstrated experience with incident response workflows — detection, escalation, remediation, and RCA.
  • Experience deploying and maintaining observability tooling (logging, metrics, tracing, alerting).
  • Proficiency in Linux administration and shell scripting (Bash, Python).
  • Strong experience with Terraform for infrastructure-as-code.
  • Experience with Atlassian tooling (Jira, JSM, Confluence).


Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience with GCP, specifically BigQuery and related data services.
  • Experience with Grafana OSS stack (Loki, Tempo, Mimir, Alloy/Faro).
  • Experience supporting Airflow or similar orchestration platforms.
  • AWS certifications (Solutions Architect Associate, SysOps, or DevOps Engineer).
  • Experience working in multi-account AWS environments with consolidated billing/cost allocation tagging.
  • Exposure to ZTNA/VPN solutions (Firezone, Twingate, or similar).

title: Professor de inglês

Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.

  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!

  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.

Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: System Architect
description:
Project Description:

Owns the end-to-end vision and AI architecture for consumer devices. Defines scalable, power-efficient, and production-ready imaging and perception systems across product lines. Drives technical direction across sensor, ISP, CV, ML, and platform integration.


Responsibilities:

  • Define and own end-to-end vision system architecture (sensor → ISP → CV/ML → application layer).
  • Translate product and UX requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Define image quality strategy aligned with AI and user experience goals.

  • Define AI model lifecycle strategy from training to OTA deployment.
  • Architect heterogeneous compute utilization (CPU/GPU/NPU/DSP).

  • Establish coding standards, modularization strategy, and long-term maintainability.
  • Identify technical risks early and define mitigation strategies.
  • Collaborate with hardware, ISP, Android/Linux platform, and product teams.
  • Mentor senior engineers and provide architectural governance.
  • Contribute to long-term vision/AI roadmap across product generations.


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field (PhD preferred).
  • 10-15+ years of experience in imaging/vision/perception systems.
  • Proven experience architecting and shipping multiple consumer products with vision/AI.
  • Deep understanding of imaging pipeline (sensor behavior, ISP, tuning impact).
  • Strong embedded system architecture experience.
  • Expert-level C++ and system-level optimization knowledge.
  • Strong expertise in CV and ML system integration.
  • Experience deploying optimized ML models on consumer SoCs.
  • Experience with heterogeneous compute architectures.
  • Experience defining system-level KPIs and validation strategies.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership and communication skills.

title: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCo

NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.

NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.

We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.

Role and responsibilities

The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.

The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.


Primary roles and responsibilities include:

Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management

  • Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
  • Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
  • Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
  • Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.

Eligibility, due diligence & agreements

  • Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
  • Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
  • Lead closure of contract signatures.
  • Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system

(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).

Reforestation delivery enablement

  • Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
  • Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
  • Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
  • Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).

Stakeholder engagement and safeguards

  • Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
  • Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism.
  • Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
  • Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.

Reporting

  • Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
  • Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.

Teamwork and culture

  • Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
  • Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.


Skills and attributes

To perform successfully in this role, you will have:

  • A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
  • Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
  • Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
  • Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
  • A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
  • A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
  • Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
  • A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.


Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.


Location

  • Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia


Submission instructions

  • Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
  • Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

description:
About You

You are a senior-level Backend Engineer (Node.js) who thrives in challenging environments and enjoys taking ownership of complex systems to transform them into secure, scalable, and production-ready solutions.


You are highly hands-on and comfortable working with evolving or partially structured codebases. You can quickly assess risks, identify critical issues, and execute remediation strategies under tight timelines. You value clean code, security best practices, and reliable system behavior.


You collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, communicate technical challenges clearly, and play a key role in stabilizing applications and restoring confidence in production systems. You are motivated by making a tangible impact and contributing to the successful relaunch and future scalability of a critical platform.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in backend development using Node.js.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Strong experience working with REST APIs and third-party integrations.
  • Proven experience handling legacy systems, codebase audits, or technical recovery scenarios.
  • Solid understanding of application security best practices, including secure handling of sensitive data.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS environments and services.
  • Experience setting up or troubleshooting CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong experience working with PostgreSQL databases (RDS preferred).
  • Familiarity with proxies, CORS, and common web security vulnerabilities (e.g., SSRF).
  • Ability to work in fast-paced environments with ambiguous or incomplete documentation.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to prioritize issues based on business impact.
  • Experience collaborating with mobile teams (React Native is a plus).
  • Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Take ownership of the Node.js backend and perform a full technical assessment of the codebase.
  • Identify and remediate critical security vulnerabilities and insecure integrations.
  • Refactor unstable or low-quality code to improve reliability, maintainability, and performance.
  • Stabilize core application flows required for production readiness.
  • Re-establish codebase ownership by organizing and migrating repositories within the client environment.
  • Analyze and restore CI/CD pipelines across repositories and environments.
  • Set up and validate staging environments to support testing and release processes.
  • Audit and stabilize third-party integrations such as payments and external platforms.
  • Collaborate with QA and stakeholders to validate functionality and prioritize fixes.
  • Support release readiness and launch execution ensuring system stability.
  • Enforce a feature-freeze approach focused on stabilization and critical fixes.
  • Contribute to defining a post-launch roadmap to support scalability and future development.
  • Continuously improve system security, performance, and operational stability.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Node.js backend development.
  • Experience working with legacy systems, system stabilization, or technical recovery projects.
  • Strong experience with AWS, CI/CD pipelines, and PostgreSQL.
  • Solid understanding of backend security and API integrations.
  • Advanced English proficiency.


Additional Information

At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication . These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (C#/.NET)
description:
We're looking for full-time, remote Senior Full Stack Software Engineers with 7+ years of experience delivering production-ready software. The ideal candidates will have recent hands-on C# /.NET, modern JS framework (Vue.js, React.js, Angular), and extensive end-to-end API and integration experience. You should thrive in fast-moving environments and be able to quickly translate ambiguous goals into working features, rapidly master new tools, and own your code from design through post-release support.


You'll collaborate with Senior and Staff engineers across North and South America, owning features from concept through production support and seeing users benefit almost immediately. If delivering practical solutions quickly and refining them in live environments motivates you, you'll fit right in.


Founded in 2003, our client transforms the traditional restaurant point-of-sale (POS) terminal into an integrated 360-degree operational management system. Their solution increases brand loyalty through improved customer experiences, optimizes operations resulting in lower costs, and increases sales volumes through comprehensive analytics and employee performance insights. Over 7,000 restaurant locations use their technology today, and they process over $5 Billion of payments annually.


Responsibilities:


  • Perform full life-cycle commercial software development and maintenance, including analyzing specifications, documenting requirements, and architecting, designing, developing, and maintaining software solutions
  • Collaborate with teams to design, develop, and produce high-quality code following best practices and standards for both new features and existing application maintenance
  • Own features end-to-end - UI through API and Data layer too
  • Support and refactor legacy code using modern methodologies and technologies
  • Analyze code to identify defect root causes and provide resolutions
  • Participate in daily standups and weekly team meetings to review priorities, progress, new ideas, and technologies
  • Address defects identified during various testing cycles
  • Perform high-quality peer reviews


Required Experience


  • Excellent written and spoken English; must be able to discuss trade-offs with teammates and stakeholders
  • 7+ years professional C#/.NET (Core and Framework) experience - recent in the last 2 years
  • Modern JavaScript framework experience (Vue.js, React.js, or Angular) - delivering new features, not just fixing bugs
  • Comfortable working end-to-end (UI, API, data layer, infra scripts); whatever it takes
  • Must have \"ownership mindset\" - you'll have the responsibility of designing, building, shipping, monitoring, and fixing the features you touch
  • Fluent in Git and modern branching / PR workflows
  • Rapid learner, as you're expected to ramp up on a new library or API in hours, not weeks
  • Team first approach displaying transparency, reliability, decisiveness, and a laser focus on customer impact
  • Rapid learner, as you're expected to ramp up on a new library or API in hours, not weeks


Desired Experience (Not Required)


  • Daily use of Docker/containers (you wrote the Dockerfile)

Additional Information


  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company, and work with smart and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - think big!

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Freight Desk Manager
description:
Position Scope

The Freight Desk Manager is a high-impact leadership role responsible for architecting and overseeing the logistics support function for non-finished goods on a global scale, with a dedicated focus on the LATAM region . This position operates at the intersection of global procurement and operational execution, managing a complex ecosystem of freight forwarders, control towers, and internal stakeholders. The mission is to ensure world-class shipment execution and financial integrity through robust audit structures and the expansion of logistics capabilities in high-growth markets.

Responsibilities and Accountabilities

  • Regional Strategy & Expansion: Serve as the primary architect for logistics operations in LATAM, including the enablement of Importer of Record (IOR) operations and regional supplier onboarding.
  • Global Freight Desk Leadership: Lead the logistics support function for specialized shipments, managing a network of global freight forwarders operating through dedicated control towers.
  • Rate Card Governance: Standardize and maintain global Bulk Air and Ocean rate cards across a diverse portfolio of international suppliers to ensure cost consistency and transparency.
  • Strategic Sourcing: Lead RFQs and supplier onboarding initiatives for logistics, ensuring all partners meet global compliance and service level standards.
  • Governance & Audit Architecture: Design and maintain a global freight audit strategy and control architecture to ensure financial discipline across high-volume global invoice environments.
  • Control Tower Oversight: Drive operational excellence by governing forwarder performance, ensuring industry-leading on-time shipment execution across all transport modes.
  • Automation & Process Engineering: Implement automated invoice approval systems and systemic controls to improve first-pass yield and overall operational efficiency.
  • Stakeholder Management: Partner with global cross-functional teams to support non-standard logistics requirements and rapid-response delivery programs.

Mandatory Requirements

  • Experience: Extensive experience in Global Supply Management, Logistics Procurement, or Supply Chain Operations within multinational environments.
  • Regional Expertise: Deep knowledge of the LATAM logistics landscape , including regulatory requirements, customs, and supplier networks.
  • Procurement Mastery: Proven track record in leading RFQs and managing complex logistics supplier onboarding processes.
  • Network Management: Experience managing large-scale global freight forwarder relationships and \"Control Tower\" operational models.
  • Technical Proficiency: Strong background in Logistics Financial Control (Freight Audit) and managing high-volume, global-scale invoice environments.
  • Leadership: Experience leading international teams and managing external providers across different time zones (APAC, EMEA, AMR).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, International Trade, or a related field.
  • Languages: Fluency in English is essential for regional and global coordination.

Desirable Requirements

  • Advanced Education: MBA or Master’s degree.
  • Process Excellence: Certifications in Lean Six Sigma or similar experience.
  • Digital Transformation: Experience implementing AI-driven or automated financial auditing and rate management tools.
  • Rapid Growth Background: Experience managing logistics for hyper-growth programs (e.g., international express expansions or specialized delivery models).

title: Professor de francês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?



  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

  • Criar documentações complementares de acordo com as necessidades do projeto;

Ensino superior completo, preferencialmente em cursos de Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou Ciência da Computação;

  • Ferramentas para deployment (ex: Jenkings, Ansible, Puppet, Chef, Travis CI, Salt),

  • Automatização de cloud (ex: Terraform, Cloud Formation),

title: Manager, Corporate Development - M&A Origination & Deal Sourcing
description:
Gemini Group (csigemini.com) is part of Constellation Software Inc. (TSX: CSU), a global acquirer, builder, and manager of vertical market software businesses. Gemini partners with high-quality software companies, providing long-term operational support, capital, and strategic guidance to help them grow sustainably. Our portfolio spans multiple vertical markets and operates through decentralized business units that are deeply embedded in their respective industries. Learn more here: csigemini.com


The Role

The Manager, Corporate Development will play a critical role in identifying, building, and nurturing strategic relationships that lead to new acquisition opportunities for Gemini Group.


In this role, you will engage with software company leaders. Your success will be measured by your ability to cultivate meaningful, trust-based relationships that ultimately result in Gemini acquiring high-quality software businesses. Relationship-building in this role is a long-term endeavor - often taking multiple years from first contact to acquisition. Success requires persistence, strategic thinking, disciplined pipeline management, high-quality market research, and a consistent ability to add value across many conversations.


As Gemini continues to expand its presence globally, this Brazil based role will also play a foundational part in helping scale Gemini’s M&A capability in the LATAM market. Over time, the Manager, Corporate Development will have the opportunity to contribute to the growth of a localized M&A function - including shaping best practices and helping establish Gemini as a preferred partner for LATAM software entrepreneurs. This is a unique chance to be a builder of Gemini’s deal-sourcing footprint in Brazil while advancing your own leadership trajectory within the organization.


Key Outcomes

  • Develop, manage, and expand an M&A pipeline using Salesforce CRM, including market mapping within assigned software verticals.
  • Meet and exceed weekly and quarterly sourcing and relationship-building KPIs.
  • Work both independently and in collaboration with Gemini’s M&A leadership to efficiently evaluate potential acquisition opportunities.
  • Ensure accurate categorization and allocation of leads within relevant portfolio verticals.
  • Effectively screen and qualify opportunities at the top of the acquisition funnel to support Portfolio Managers and operating teams.
  • Support the long-term build-out of Gemini’s LATAM/Brazil M&A presence by contributing to sourcing processes, knowledge sharing, and future team development.
  • Engage directly with founders, CEOs, and controlling shareholders, conducting high-quality M&A conversations to understand ownership dynamics, M&A insights, motivations, business insights and timing of a future, potential deal.
  • Qualify opportunities through initial commercial, operational, and financial assessment, filtering deals before internal escalation.
  • Coordinate internally with global teams (Perseus / CSI) to align on pipeline prioritization and strategic fit.
  • Maintain structured tracking of interactions and insights (CRM-driven), ensuring continuity and depth of relationship over time.


Relevant Experience & Competencies

  • At least three years of experience in M&A business development, with proven involvement in various aspects of M&A such as mandate origination (including private equity), initial contact with key decision-makers, deal negotiation, or client-facing roles in M&A or finance within the software or technology sector.
  • Experience in outbound deal origination planning.
  • Previous exposure on relationship-building meetings (virtual or in-person) with company owners to explore strategic M&A opportunities.
  • Demonstrated interest in building a long-term career in software investing, M&A, or corporate development.
  • Track record of high performance in business development, entrepreneurship, or other competitive environments.
  • Strong executive presence with the ability to confidently engage senior leaders, including CEOs, investors, and advisors.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working autonomously.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and results-driven with a strong sense of urgency.


Other Requirements

  • Willingness to travel occasionally within Brazil and broader LATAM as well as internationally to Canada, the U.S., and Portugal.
  • Professional working proficiency in both English and Portuguese is required.
  • Professional working proficiency in Spanish is a bonus.

title: English Teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.
